paragraphs: Redwire is an integrated space and defense technology company focused on advanced technologies. The Company's vision is to pioneer next-generation space and defense technologies that empower scientific discovery, advance global industries, and strengthen security - transforming how humanity explores, connects, and protects - from the skies above to the stars beyond. Powered by this vision, Redwire is building the future of aerospace infrastructure, autonomous systems, and multi-domain operations, leveraging digital engineering and artificial intelligence ("AI") automation.

Redwire's broad portfolio of airborne and space-based systems combine decades of flight heritage with an agile and innovative culture. Through its global operations, Redwire's technologies are deployed across national security, civil, and commercial space and defense technology market segments globally. Operating out of 28 locations in North America and Europe, Redwire serves a diverse set of domestic and international customers. For a discussion of risks associated with our operations, refer to Item 1A. "Risk Factors."

Redwire's strategy to accelerate growth includes bundled sales and increased levels of offering integrations, such as systems, payloads, space and airborne platforms and full mission solutions. Our strategy also includes strategic acquisitions to complement and expand the Company's space and defense technologies. Our scale, reputation for quality and relationships allow us to be agile and innovative in our approach to pursuing growth through business models, partnerships and acquisitions.

Effective December 1, 2025, the Company operated in two operating segments and two reportable segments: Space and Defense Tech. Refer to Note B – Summary of Significant Accounting Policies and Note U – Segment Reporting of the accompanying notes to the consolidated financial statements for additional information regarding this conclusion.

Redwire's Space segment focuses on delivering next-generation spacecraft, large space infrastructure, and microgravity capabilities to serve civil, national security, and commercial space customers globally. Redwire's core space offerings are flight-proven and have supported hundreds of spacecraft, missions, and operations, including, but not limited to, the International Space Station ("ISS"), European Space Agency's ("ESA") Project for On-Board Autonomy ("PROBA") missions, National Aeronautics and Space Administration's ("NASA") Double Asteroid Redirection Test ("DART") and Artemis I lunar mission, and Space Force's GPS Satellite program.

Redwire's spacecraft portfolio features a lineup of five platforms - SabreSat, Phantom, Hammerhead, Thresher, and Mako - designed to operate across multiple orbits ranging from Very Low Earth Orbit ("VLEO"), Low Earth Orbit ("LEO"), Medium Earth Orbit ("MEO"), Geostationary Orbit ("GEO") and beyond GEO ("X-GEO"). For VLEO, Redwire offers two spacecraft: U.S.-built SaberSat and the European-built Phantom spacecraft. Both VLEO spacecraft are designed to unlock capability in a less congested orbit where proximity to Earth provides imaging and low latency advantages. Redwire is the prime mission integrator on the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's ("DARPA") Otter program in the U.S., which is leveraging the SabreSat platform to develop a revolutionary air-breathing satellite system and will demonstrate the use of novel electric propulsion in VLEO. Additionally, Redwire's Phantom spacecraft is being used on ESA's Skimsat VLEO program.

In LEO, Redwire offers its U.S.-built Thresher spacecraft. In MEO and GEO, Redwire offers its U.S.-built Mako spacecraft. Both platforms are designed for challenging missions that address dynamic space operations where maneuverability, precision accuracy, and autonomous operation are critical. Mako is designed for high precision rendezvous proximity operations ("RPO"), docking, and in-space refueling. It has the capability to support dynamic space operations and the adaptability to host a variety of mission payloads. Additionally, Mako serves space situational awareness and scientific missions at GEO and X-GEO orbits. Thresher is also highly maneuverable and is designed for rapid response, having demonstrated the capability to deliver within one year after contract award.

Redwire also provides the EU-based LEO Hammerhead, a small satellite platform which is capable of supporting payloads of up to 70 kg and targets spacecraft with a mass of less than 200 kg, making it compatible with typical shared launch opportunities and small satellite launchers. The Hammerhead platform is an evolution of the PROBA platform, which has accumulated extensive flight heritage of more than 50 years in orbit without failure on any of the launched satellites. We are leading small satellite pioneering research missions like PROBA-1 and PROBA-3, ESA's small satellite with fully autonomous capabilities, and PROBA-V, ESA's operational Earth observation mission based on a small satellite. The PROBA-3 satellites demonstrate precision formation flying, a foundational building block to the advancement of future multi-satellite missions.

Redwire also provides software that supports mission assessments and design of new missions such as operation in VLEO and dynamic space operations in GEO. Redwire's digital engineering facilitates the modeling and simulation of prospective space architectures to support trade analysis, operational concepts, and testing. Redwire leverages high-fidelity digital engineering tools and

model-based systems engineering to produce end-to-end virtual environments that decrease cost, increase speed to market, and enable mission optimization. Redwire has a proprietary enterprise software suite that enables digital engineering and generation of high-fidelity, interactive modeling and simulations of individual components, as well as entire spacecraft and full constellations in a cloud-based environment.

Redwire is a leading innovator in space infrastructure, enabling space mission providers with the foundational building blocks and integrated solutions needed for complex space missions in areas including power generation and spacecraft docking. Redwire is developing critical space infrastructure that is impacting our terrestrial economy in areas, such as national security, global defense, telecommunications, navigation and timing, and Earth observation.

Power generation is critical for space missions and Redwire offers a variety of solar array solutions for spacecraft, spanning the spectrum of size, power needs, and desired orbit. Redwire's proprietary technologies, technical experience, and large-scale production facilities enable the Company to design, build, and deliver competitive power generation solutions tailored to customer needs. Redwire's patented and award-winning Roll-Out Solar Array ("ROSA") technology features an innovative "roll-out" design that uses composite booms to serve as both the primary structural elements and the deployment actuator, and a modular photovoltaic blanket assembly that can be configured into a variety of solar array architectures. When configured for launch, ROSA stows into a compact cylindrical volume yielding efficient space utilization, which allows extremely large solar arrays to be stowed compactly within launch vehicles.

Redwire's power systems have successfully deployed on several flight missions in LEO, GEO, and deep space, including on the ISS, NASA's Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer ("IXPE") mission, and NASA's DART mission.

Additionally, to enable some of humanity's most advanced missions in LEO and deep space, Redwire has developed a state-of-the-art docking system, the International Berthing and Docking Mechanism ("IBDM"), to support autonomous rendezvous and docking capabilities for spacecraft. The IBDM is fully computer-controlled and designed for use with both large mass and lightweight spacecraft. Redwire's IBDM system is fully aligned with the international docking system standard and can be used for autonomous docking of crewed vehicles, cargo vehicles station modules as well as resource transfer through automated umbilical mating.

headings: Results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024:
paragraphs: Redwire is an integrated space and defense technology company focused on advanced technologies including space infrastructure, autonomous systems and multi-domain operations leveraging digital engineering and artificial intelligence automation. Redwire's proven and reliable space and defense technology capabilities include our space and defense technology and platform offerings of

avionics, sensors, and payloads; power generation; structures and mechanisms; radio frequency systems; airborne and spacecraft platforms and missions; and microgravity payloads. Redwire combines decades of flight heritage and proven experience with an agile and innovative culture.

Redwire's primary business model is providing proven, mission critical solutions based on space and defense technology offerings through both short- and long-duration projects for U.S. and international government and commercial customers. Redwire operates in two business segments: Space and Defense Tech. We organize our business segments based on the nature of the products and services offered.

Redwire's Space segment focuses on delivering next-generation spacecraft, large space infrastructure, and microgravity capabilities to serve civil, national security, and commercial space customers globally. Our core space offerings are flight-proven and have supported hundreds of spacecraft, missions, and operations, including, but not limited to, the International Space Station, the European Space Agency's ("ESA") Project for On-Board Autonomy ("PROBA"), the National Aeronautics and Space Administration's ("NASA") Double Asteroid Redirection Test and the Orion space capsule, and the Space Force's GPS. We are also a provider of innovative technologies with the potential to help transform the economics of space and create new markets for its exploration and commercialization.

Redwire's Defense Tech segment focuses on delivering combat-proven autonomous systems, optical sensors, advanced optics, resilient energy solutions and radio frequency payloads that provide intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance capabilities for customers including the U.S. Department of War ("DoW", formerly known as the Department of Defense), U.S. Federal Civilian Agencies and allied governments across multiple domains. Our defense technology offerings include field-proven airborne products and services that have decades of innovation and more than 400 thousand flight hours. Key operations include developing and manufacturing Uncrewed Aerial Systems ("UAS") for commercial, government, and military applications in areas such as surveillance, logistics, reconnaissance, border security, and emergency response. Redwire is committed to delivering innovative space and airborne platforms to help transform the future of multi-domain operations.
Selected operational developments for the year ended December 31, 2025 are described below.

•Strengthened leadership in Very Low Earth Orbit ("VLEO") with the award of a $44 million phase 2 contract to advance the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Otter mission, which leverages Redwire's SabreSat.

•Entered into an eight-figure agreement with The Exploration Company ("TEC") to provide two International Berthing and Docking Mechanisms ("IBDM") to support autonomous rendezvous and docking capabilities for TEC's Nyx spacecraft.
•Launched 14 PIL-BOXes, studying 18 unique molecules, to the International Space Station ("ISS"); as of December 31, 2025, Redwire had eleven active payload facilities on the ISS.
•Completed acquisition of Edge Autonomy, a leading provider of field-proven uncrewed aerial systems ("UAS") on June 13, 2025.

•Delivered more than 100 Stalker/Penguin UAS to customers in 7 countries around the world subsequent to the Edge Autonomy acquisition, including the U.S. Army (directly and via the Long Range Reconnaissance ("LRR") program), U.S. Marine Corps, NATO and other allied nations.

•Opened a new 85,000 square foot facility in Ann Arbor, Michigan to increase production of critical fuel cells to meet growing demand, reflecting a key investment in a domestic, vertical integration strategy for Stalker UAS production.

paragraphs: Redwire 是一家整合性太空與防禦科技公司，專注於先進科技。本公司願景是開拓下一代太空與防禦科技，以促進科學發現、推動全球產業發展，並強化安全，改變人類如何從天空到星際進行探索、連線與保護的方式。基於此願景，Redwire 正在建設航太基礎設施、自主系統與多域作戰的未來，運用數位工程與人工智慧（"AI"）自動化。
Redwire 的廣泛產品組合包含空中與空間系統，結合數十年的飛行經驗與靈活創新文化。透過其全球運營，Redwire 的科技應用於國家安全、民用與商業太空與防禦科技市場 globally。運營於北美與歐洲的 28 個據點，Redwire 服務多樣化的國內與國際客戶。有關本公司運營相關風險的討論，請參閱第 1A 項 "風險因素"。
Redwire 加速成長的策略包括捆綁銷售與提高提供整合的層級，例如系統、載荷、空間與空中平台與完整任務解決方案。我們的策略也包含戰略收購，以補足與擴展本公司在太空與防禦科技的領域。我們的規模、品質聲譽與關係，使我們能以靈活創新的方式追求成長，透過商業模式、合作夥伴與收購。
自 2025 年 12 月 1 日起，本公司運營於兩個運營分部與兩個應報告分部：太空與防禦科技。請參閱附註 B – 重要會計政策摘要與附註 U – 分部報告，以取得關於此結論的更多資訊。

Redwire 的太空分部專注於交付下一代太空船、大型太空基礎設施與微重力能力，以服務全球民用、國家安全與商業太空客戶。Redwire 的核心太空產品已通過飛行驗證，並支援數百艘太空船、任務與運作，包括但不限於國際太空站（"ISS"）、歐洲太空總署（"ESA"）的 onboard 自動化計畫（"PROBA"）任務、美國國家航空航天局（"NASA"）的雙小行星改道測試（"DART"）與阿耳忒彌斯一號月球任務，以及太空軍的 GPS 衛星計畫。

Redwire 的太空船產品組合包含五種平台 – SabreSat、Phantom、Hammerhead、Thresher 與 Mako – 設計用於多種軌道，從非常低地球軌道（"VLEO"）、低地球軌道（"LEO"）、中地球軌道（"MEO"）、地球同步軌道（"GEO"）以及超越 GEO（"X-GEO"）。在 VLEO，Redwire 提供兩種太空船：美國製 SaberSat 與歐洲製 Phantom 太空船。兩種 VLEO 太空船均設計用於較少擁擠的軌道，靠近地球可提供影像與低延遲優勢。Redwire 是美國國防高等研究計畫署（"DARPA"）Otter 計畫的主承包商，該計畫利用 SabreSat 平台開發革命性的吸氣式衛星系統，並展示新型電推進在 VLEO 的應用。此外，Redwire 的 Phantom 太空船正用於 ESA 的 Skimsat VLEO 計畫。

在 LEO，Redwire 提供其美國製 Thresher 太空船。在 MEO 與 GEO，Red於提供其美國製 Mako 太空船。兩種平台均設計用於具有挑戰性的任務，以應對動態太空運作，其中 manoeuvrability、精確度與自主運作至關重要。Mako 設計用於高精確度接近與近距離運作（"RPO"）、 docking 與太空加油。它具有支援動態太空運作與適應多種任務載荷的靈活性。此外，Mako 服務 GEO 與 X-GEO 軌道的太空情資監測與科學任務。Thresher 也具有高度 manoeuvrability，設計用於快速反應，已展示在合約簽訂後一年內交付的能力。

Redwire 還提供 EU 的 LEO Hammerhead，一種小型衛星平台，可支援最多 70 公斤的載荷，並針對質量低於 200 公斤的衛星，使其與常見的共享發射機會與小型衛星發射器相容。Hammerhead 平台是 PROBA 平台的進化版，該平台已累積超過 50 年的飛行經驗，所有發射的衛星均無故障。我們領導小型衛星先導研究任務，如 PROBA-1 與 PROBA-3，ESA 的小型衛星具完全自主能力，以及 PROBA-V，ESA 的運營地球觀測任務，基於小型衛星。PROBA-3 衛星展示精確編隊飛行，是未來多衛星任務進步的基礎建設塊。

Redwire 亦提供軟體，用以支援任務評估及新任務的設計，例如在VLEO運作及GEO的動態空間運作。Redwire 的數位工程可協助建模與模擬未來的空間架構，以支援交易分析、作戰概念及測試。Redwire 優化高保真度數位工程工具及模型導向系統工程，以產生端到端的虛擬環境，降低成本、提高市場進入速度，並實現任務最佳化。Redwire 有一套專屬企業軟體組合，可支援數位工程及產生高保真度、互動式建模與模擬，包括個別零組件、整個衛星以及完整的衛星星座，皆於雲端環境中進行。
Redwire 是空間基礎設施領域的領導創新者，為空間任務提供者提供複雜空間任務所需的基礎建設元件及整合解決方案，包括電力產生及衛星 docking。Redwire 正在開發關鍵性的空間基礎設施，這些設施正在影響我們的地面經濟，涉及領域包括國家安全、全球防禦、電信、導航與時鐘同步，以及地球觀測。
Redwire 是空間基礎設施領域的領導創新者，為空間任務提供者提供複雜空間任務所需的基礎建設元件及整合解決方案，包括電力產生及衛星 docking。Redwire 正在開發關鍵性的空間基礎設施，這些設施正在影響我們的地面經濟，涉及領域包括國家安全、全球防禦、電信、導航與時鐘同步，以及地球觀測。

太空任務的電力產生至關重要，Redwire 提供多種太陽能板解決方案，用於飛行器，涵蓋不同尺寸、電力需求及所需軌道範圍。Redwire 的專利技術、技術經驗與大規模生產設施，使本公司能設計、製造並交付符合客戶需求的競爭性電力產生解決方案。Redwire 的專利且獲獎的 Roll-Out Solar Array ("ROSA") 技術，具創新 "展開" 設計，使用複合材質支架作為主要結構元件與展開機械裝置，並搭配模組化光電毯組裝，可配置為多種太陽能板架構。當配置為發射時，ROSA 可收納至緊湊的圓柱體空間，實現空間高效利用，使極大尺寸的太陽能板能緊湊收納於發射載具內。
Redwire 的電力系統已成功部署於多個低地軌道（LEO）、靜止軌道（GEO）及深空飛行任務，包括國際太空站（ISS）、美國國家航空航天局（NASA）的 Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer ("IXPE") 計畫，以及 NASA 的 DART 計畫。

此外，為使人類能執行最先進的 LEO 與深空任務，Redwire 開發了先進的 docking 系統，國際接駁與 docking 裝置（"IBDM"），以支援飛行器的自動會合與 docking 功能。IBDM 系統為全電腦控制，設計用於大型與輕量飛行器。Redwire 的 IBDM 系統完全符合國際 docking 系統標準，可用於載人飛行器、貨運飛行器、站內模組以及透過自動化 umbilical 連接進行資源轉移。

paragraphs: Redwire 為一間整合性太空與防衛科技公司，專注於先進科技，包括太空基礎建設、自主系統與多域作戰，運用數位工程與人工智慧自動化技術。Redwire 已驗證且可靠的太空與防衛科技能力，包含我們的太空與防衛科技與平台產品與服務為
航電系統、感測器與酬載；電力產生；結構與機械；射頻系統；空中與太空飛行器平台與任務；以及微重力酬載。Redwire 結合數十年的飛行經驗與已驗證的專業能力，搭配靈活且創新文化。
Redwire 的主要商業模式為透過短、長期專案，為美國與國際政府與商業客戶提供已驗證、攸關任務成功的解決方案，基於太空與防衛科技產品與服務。Redwire 運作於兩個業務分部：太空與防衛科技。我們依產品與服務的性質來組織業務分部。

Redwire 的太空分部專注於提供下一代飛行器、大型太空基礎建設與微重力能力，以服務全球民用、國家安全與商業太空客戶。我們的核心太空產品與服務為已飛行驗證，已支援數百艘飛行器、任務與作戰，包括但不限於國際太空站、歐洲太空總署（"ESA"）的在軌自主性計畫（"PROBA"）、美國國家航空暨太空總署（"NASA"）的雙小行星改道測試（Double Asteroid Redirection Test）與奧林（Orion）太空艙，以及美國太空軍的 GPS。我們同時也是創新科技的供應商，具備潛力協助改變太空經濟，並創造新的市場用以探索與商業化太空。

Redwire 的防衛科技分部專注於提供已驗證的自主系統、光學感測器、先進光學、堅韌能源解決方案與射頻酬載，為客戶提供情報、監視與偵察能力，客戶包括美國國防部（"DoW"，原為美國國防部）、美國聯邦民營機構與盟國政府，橫跨多個域。我們的防衛科技產品與服務包含已驗證的空中產品與服務，擁有數十年創新與超過 400,000 小時飛行時數。關鍵作業包括開發與製造無人飛行器系統（"UAS"）用於商業、政府與軍事應用，領域包括監視、物流、偵察、邊境安全與緊急應變。Redwire 承諾提供創新太空與空中平台，協助改變多域作戰的未來。
2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度的重點運營發展如下所述。
•強化在極低地球軌道（"VLEO"）的領導地位，獲得了價值 44 百萬美元的第二階段契約，用以推進美國防部先進研究計畫局（"DARPA"）的 Otter 計畫，此計畫運用 Redwire 的 SabreSat。
•與探索公司（"TEC"）簽訂一筆八位數的契約，提供兩組國際接駁與 docking 系統（"IBDM"），以支援 TEC 的 Nyx 飛行器自主會合與 docking 能力。
•發佈 14 組 PIL-BOX，研究 18 種獨特分子，送往國際太空站（"ISS"）；截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Redwire 在國際太空站上有 11 組活躍的載荷設施。
•於 2025 年 6 月 13 日完成收購 Edge Autonomy，為提供經過實地驗證的無人機系統（"UAS"）的領導供應商。
•在收購 Edge Autonomy 之後，向全球 7 國客戶交付超過 100 組 Stalker/Penguin UAS，包括美國陸軍（直接及透過長距離偵察（"LRR"）計畫）、美國海軍陸戰隊、NATO 及其他盟國。
•在密歇根州安那波利斯開設一座 85,000 平方英呎的新廠房，以增加關鍵燃料電池的生產，以應對日益增長的需求，反映本公司在 Stalker UAS 生產上對國內垂直整合策略的重要投資。

paragraphs: 讀者應謹慎考量下列風險因素，並配合本年度報告表 10-K 所包含的所有其他資訊。 herein 所描述的風險與不確定性，可能並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險，且並未按優先順序排列。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前管理層尚未知悉，或管理層目前認為不重要，也可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。若上述任何風險與不確定性發展為實際事件，可能會影響本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果，導致本公司普通股交易價格下跌，或導致實際結果與預期結果有重大差異。

• 地緣政治與總體經濟事件及條件可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成不利影響；
